title: Drops in India This Week (Mon 23 Nov 2026): Comet Kaali Peeli ₹5,299 on sale since 22 Nov; Golden Goose × D'YAVOL X in India 24 Nov (price at launch); Air Jordan 4 OG 'Bred' ₹19,995 on 27 Nov at Superkicks and VegNonVeg
headline: Drops in India This Week, Led by Comet's ₹5,299 Kaali Peeli

facts.fact: Comet Kaali Peeli (X Lows) is ₹5,299 MRP incl. taxes, limited pairs on Comet's website; tribute to Mumbai's Premier Padmini kaali-peeli taxis; PAL-badge tongue, MH-01 heel plate, back tabs 'For Hire' / 'Nahi Jayenge'
Kaali Peeli went on sale 22 Nov (6 PM per StartupPedia; product published 22 Nov per Comet's store data); Comet is Bengaluru-based

Golden Goose × D'YAVOL X first release 24 Nov 2026, online in India and at Golden Goose stores in New Delhi (The Chanakya), Mumbai (Phoenix Palladium), Bengaluru (Phoenix Mall of Asia); no India prices listed yet
Capsule: reworked Super-Star in silver laminated leather/black suede, white leather/red suede star, two black leather styles; plus a jacket, T-shirts, hoodies
D'YAVOL X was founded by Shah Rukh Khan, Aryan Khan, Leti Blagoeva and Bunty Singh

Air Jordan 4 OG 'Bred' (IX8180-001) ₹19,995 MRP at Superkicks and VegNonVeg, releases Fri 27 Nov; VegNonVeg early reservation (ships from 27 Nov); Superkicks pre-order with 27 Nov 2026 on its launch calendar
